items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And we had quite a few lessons together. Mrs. Marble, I'll never forget her.

ctx.x: Yeah. A lady named Miz Marble who had gone to a, some school in Michigan which was quite a distance from Texas, especially to me. I said, "Wow, Michigan, this … due north almost." She had been infatuated with the great George Gershwin and I'm sure she had a big crush on him; I mean musically, you know. [laughs] I think she'd even met him once. She taught … I learned Rhapsody in Blue as best I could through her. And she was Caucasian so we had to meet – still in the '40s – in a used church, which was sort of like…
nothing worse than having your dogs uncomfortable.
